note: Criterion text is a concise normalized representation with canonical W3C URLs, not verbatim normative prose.

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.normativeText: Provide text alternatives for non-text content so it can be changed into other forms people need.

criteria.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.normativeText: Provide an alternative for prerecorded audio-only and video-only media, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.normativeText: Provide captions for prerecorded synchronized media except when the media is itself a media alternative for text.

criteria.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.normativeText: Provide audio description or a media alternative for prerecorded synchronized media except when it is a media alternative for text.

criteria.title: Captions (Live)
criteria.normativeText: Provide captions for live synchronized media.

criteria.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.normativeText: Provide audio description for prerecorded synchronized media.

criteria.title: Info and Relationships
criteria.normativeText: Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.

criteria.title: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.normativeText: When content order affects meaning, a correct reading sequence can be programmatically determined.

criteria.title: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.normativeText: Instructions do not rely only on sensory characteristics such as shape, color, size, visual location, orientation, or sound.

criteria.title: Orientation
criteria.normativeText: Content does not restrict operation to a single display orientation unless a specific orientation is essential.

criteria.title: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.normativeText: The purpose of user-information inputs can be programmatically determined when the input purpose is listed by WCAG and technology support exists.

criteria.title: Use of Color
criteria.normativeText: Color is not the only visual means of conveying information, indicating action, prompting response, or distinguishing an element.

criteria.title: Audio Control
criteria.normativeText: Audio that plays automatically for more than three seconds can be paused, stopped, or controlled independently from system volume.

criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.normativeText: Text and images of text meet minimum contrast thresholds, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Resize Text
criteria.normativeText: Text can be resized up to 200 percent without assistive technology and without loss of content or functionality, except captions and images of text.

criteria.title: Images of Text
criteria.normativeText: Use text rather than images of text where the visual presentation can be achieved with technology, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Reflow
criteria.normativeText: Content can be presented without two-dimensional scrolling at WCAG-defined viewport sizes, except parts requiring two-dimensional layout.

criteria.title: Non-text Contrast
criteria.normativeText: Visual information needed to identify user interface components and graphical objects has sufficient contrast, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Text Spacing
criteria.normativeText: No content or functionality is lost when text spacing is adjusted to the WCAG-defined minimum values.

criteria.title: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.normativeText: Additional content triggered by hover or focus is dismissible, hoverable, and persistent, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.normativeText: All functionality is operable through a keyboard interface, except where path-dependent input is essential.

criteria.title: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.normativeText: Keyboard focus can be moved away from components using only a keyboard interface.

criteria.title: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.normativeText: Single-character keyboard shortcuts can be turned off, remapped, or active only on focus.

criteria.title: Timing Adjustable
criteria.normativeText: Users can turn off, adjust, or extend time limits, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.normativeText: Moving, blinking, scrolling, auto-updating, or longer animated content can be paused, stopped, hidden, or controlled as WCAG requires.

criteria.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.normativeText: Web pages do not contain flashing above WCAG-defined flash thresholds.

criteria.title: Bypass Blocks
criteria.normativeText: A mechanism is available to bypass blocks of content repeated on multiple pages.

criteria.title: Page Titled
criteria.normativeText: Web pages have titles that describe topic or purpose.

criteria.title: Focus Order
criteria.normativeText: Focusable components receive focus in an order that preserves meaning and operability.

criteria.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.normativeText: The purpose of each link can be determined from link text alone or link text together with its programmatically determined context, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Multiple Ways
criteria.normativeText: More than one way is available to locate a web page within a set of web pages, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Headings and Labels
criteria.normativeText: Headings and labels describe topic or purpose.

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.normativeText: Keyboard-operable user interfaces have a visible mode of operation showing keyboard focus.

criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.normativeText: When a component receives keyboard focus, it is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.

criteria.title: Pointer Gestures
criteria.normativeText: Multipoint or path-based pointer gestures can be operated with a single pointer without path-based gestures unless essential.

criteria.title: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.normativeText: Single-pointer functionality follows WCAG pointer cancellation requirements unless down-event completion is essential.

criteria.title: Label in Name
criteria.normativeText: User interface components with text or images of text labels include that text in the accessible name.

criteria.title: Motion Actuation
criteria.normativeText: Functionality operated by device or user motion can also be operated by user interface components and motion response can be disabled, with exceptions.

criteria.title: Dragging Movements
criteria.normativeText: Functionality using dragging movement can be achieved by a single pointer without dragging unless dragging is essential or user-agent determined.

criteria.title: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.normativeText: Pointer input targets meet WCAG minimum size or spacing requirements, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Language of Page
criteria.normativeText: The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined.

criteria.title: Language of Parts
criteria.normativeText: The human language of each passage or phrase can be programmatically determined, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: On Focus
criteria.normativeText: Receiving focus does not initiate a change of context.

criteria.title: On Input
criteria.normativeText: Changing the setting of a user interface component does not automatically cause a change of context unless users are advised beforehand.

criteria.title: Consistent Navigation
criteria.normativeText: Repeated navigation mechanisms occur in the same relative order unless the user initiates a change.

criteria.title: Consistent Identification
criteria.normativeText: Components with the same functionality are identified consistently.

criteria.title: Consistent Help
criteria.normativeText: Help mechanisms repeated across pages appear in the same relative order unless the user initiates a change.

criteria.title: Error Identification
criteria.normativeText: Detected input errors are identified and described to the user in text.

criteria.title: Labels or Instructions
criteria.normativeText: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.

criteria.title: Error Suggestion
criteria.normativeText: Known correction suggestions for input errors are provided unless doing so would jeopardize security or purpose.

criteria.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.normativeText: For legal, financial, or data-change submissions, submissions are reversible, checked, or confirmed.

criteria.title: Redundant Entry
criteria.normativeText: Information previously entered by or provided to the user need not be re-entered in the same process, with WCAG-defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.normativeText: Authentication processes do not require cognitive function tests unless an accessible alternative, assistance mechanism, or object-recognition exception applies.

criteria.title: Name, Role, Value
criteria.normativeText: For user interface components, name and role can be programmatically determined, states/properties/values can be set, and changes are available to assistive technologies.

criteria.title: Status Messages
criteria.normativeText: Status messages can be programmatically determined through role or properties so assistive technologies can present them without focus.
